name: Om Namah Shivaya
description: A salutation to Shiva, the inner Self. Chanted for surrender, transformation, and inner stillness.

name: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra
description: The 'great death-conquering' mantra, chanted for healing, protection, and longevity.

name: Hare Krishna Maha Mantra
excerpt: हरे कृष्ण हरे कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण हरे हरे…
description: The maha-mantra of bhakti yoga, chanted for devotion and joyful surrender.

name: Om Mani Padme Hum
description: The jewel in the lotus — a mantra of compassion central to Tibetan Buddhist practice.

name: Gayatri Mantra
description: The ultimate prayer for enlightenment and universal light. It stimulates the intellect and purifies the subconscious mind, leading the practitioner toward higher consciousness.

name: Om Gam Ganapataye Namaha
description: An invocation to Ganesha, remover of obstacles, chanted before new beginnings.

name: Om Shanti Shanti Shanti
description: A threefold invocation of peace — of body, speech, and mind.

name: Lokah Samastah Sukhino Bhavantu
description: May all beings everywhere be happy and free — a closing dedication chant.

name: Om
description: The primordial sound — the vibration from which all creation arises. Chanted to still and centre the mind.

name: So Hum
description: "I am That" — a breath mantra: So on the in-breath, Hum on the out-breath.

name: Asato Ma Sadgamaya
excerpt: असतो मा सद्गमय। तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय…
description: Lead me from the unreal to the real, from darkness to light, from death to immortality.

name: Om Suryaya Namah
description: A salutation to Surya, the sun, chanted at dawn for vitality and clarity.

name: Har Har Mahadev
description: A joyful cry of praise to Mahadeva, the great god Shiva.

name: Shivoham
description: "I am Shiva" — a non-dual mantra affirming oneness with pure consciousness.

name: Om Namo Narayanaya
description: A salutation to Narayana (Vishnu), chanted for protection and equanimity.

name: Om Vishnave Namah
description: A salutation to Vishnu, the preserver, chanted for balance and protection.

name: Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya
description: A salutation to Vasudeva (Krishna/Vishnu), chanted for grace and devotion.

name: Om Shri Krishnaya Namah
description: A salutation to Krishna, the beloved, chanted for love and devotion.

name: Radhe Radhe
description: The name of Radha, Krishna's beloved — the heartbeat of devotion in Vrindavan.

name: Sri Rama Jaya Rama
deva: श्री राम जय राम जय जय राम
chant: Shri Ram Jai Ram Jai Jai Ram
description: A devotional chant to Rama, embodiment of dharma and steadfastness.

name: Sita Ram
description: The names of the divine couple Sita and Rama, chanted for devotion and harmony.

name: Om Shri Ramaya Namah
description: A salutation to Rama, embodiment of dharma, chanted for strength of character.

name: Om Ham Hanumate Namah
description: Invokes Hanuman for courage, strength, and fearless devotion.

name: Om Shri Hanumate Namah
description: A salutation to Hanuman, Rama's devoted servant, chanted for protection and resolve.

name: Shri Ganeshaya Namah
description: Salutations to Ganesha — the auspicious first words before any undertaking.

name: Vakratunda Mahakaya
description: A prayer to Ganesha to keep every endeavour free of obstacles, always.

name: Om Aim Saraswatyai Namah
description: An invocation to Saraswati, goddess of knowledge, art, and clarity of speech.

name: Om Dum Durgayei Namaha
description: Invokes Durga, the protective Mother, for strength and freedom from fear.

name: Om Shri Mahalakshmyai Namah
description: Invokes Lakshmi, goddess of abundance, for prosperity and grace.

name: Navarna Mantra
deva: ॐ ऐं ह्रीं क्लीं चामुण्डायै विच्चे
chant: Om Aim Hreem Kleem Chamundaye Vichche
description: The nine-syllable mantra of the Divine Mother, central to Navratri sadhana.

name: Om Kreem Kalikayei Namah
description: Invokes Kali, who cuts through ego and fear.

name: Guru Brahma Guru Vishnu
description: Honours the guru as Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva — the teacher as the Absolute itself.

name: Om Sai Ram
description: A remembrance of Shirdi Sai Baba, chanted for faith (shraddha) and patience (saburi).

name: Namo Buddhaya
description: Homage to the Buddha, the awakened one — chanted for mindfulness and refuge.

name: Waheguru
description: "Wondrous Enlightener" — the Sikh name of the Divine, repeated in simran (remembrance).
